title: Koshakan
author: Moldir
style: A hand-painted children's picture book world: loose watercolour washes on cold-pressed paper, wobbly ink outlines, muted earthy palette (moss, warm brown, soft grey, pale dandelion yellow), soft edges, plenty of air.

Mirai.look: A small lamb girl standing upright: caramel-russet curly wool on head and ears, cream-ivory body, a pink ribbon bow on the right side of her head, a pink tutu skirt, cloven hooves, bright round eyes.

Mama.look: An adult sheep mother standing upright: long soft-wavy dark-brown hair past her shoulders, gentle oval face, dark almond eyes, cream-ivory fleece, a dusty sage-green knee-length V-neck dress, cloven hooves.

scenes.title: Mama wakes Mirai with the word
scenes.place: Mirai's small bedroom in early morning, pale peach light before sunrise: a child's bed with a soft blanket, a window, a nightstand, a rug. A hand-painted children's picture book world: loose watercolour washes on cold-pressed paper, wobbly ink outlines, muted earthy palette (moss, warm brown, soft grey, pale dandelion yellow), soft edges, plenty of air.
scenes.ref_cues: Small cosy child's bedroom, warm cream walls. A low honey-wood child's bed with round ball knobs on the four posts, a heart cut-out in the footboard, a fat white pillow and a cream quilt with tiny pink flowers. Behind the bed a small four-pane window with sheer cream curtains tied back with ribbons, peach-gold sunrise outside. Soft warm watercolour light, plain warm floor. Nothing dark, nothing rusty.

scenes.title: Warm tap water and a drippy Koshakan
scenes.place: A small cosy bathroom on a bright morning: a sink with a tap, a little step stool in front of it, a shelf with a yellow rubber duck, a towel, soft morning light. A hand-painted children's picture book world: loose watercolour washes on cold-pressed paper, wobbly ink outlines, muted earthy palette (moss, warm brown, soft grey, pale dandelion yellow), soft edges, plenty of air.
scenes.ref_cues: Small warm bathroom, cream-beige plastered walls. A white pedestal washbasin with an arched chrome tap and two cross-handle chrome taps. A small wooden step stool in front of the basin. Above it a wooden wall shelf with a potted trailing ivy, a yellow rubber duck and a white soap pump. A wooden towel rail with a cream towel. Everything clean, white porcelain, warm wood. Nothing rusty, no dark grime.

scenes.title: The dandelion meadow: what Koshakan means
scenes.place: An open dandelion meadow field outdoors on a warm afternoon turning to sunset: soft green grass, patches of yellow dandelions and white dandelion clocks, a few low bushes and stones, a wide pale sky, no fences, no buildings. A hand-painted children's picture book world: loose watercolour washes on cold-pressed paper, wobbly ink outlines, muted earthy palette (moss, warm brown, soft grey, pale dandelion yellow), soft edges, plenty of air.
scenes.ref_cues: Open soft meadow under a hazy pale cream-yellow sky. Dense knee-high grass, thick with yellow dandelion flowers and white dandelion seed clocks everywhere, seeds floating in the air. Gentle, flat, no trees nearby, misty horizon. Warm muted greens and pale yellows.
